text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research article presenting the Land Use and Carbon Scenario Simulator (LUCAS), a spatially-explicit state-and-transition simulation model developed and applied at the national scale for the conterminous U.S. The primary focus is on LULC prediction and simulation, explicitly modeling future LULC scenarios (including multiple IPCC-SRES scenarios) with mapped outputs. The paper details national-scale spatial implementation, harmonization of multiple national datasets to define initial conditions, spatial multipliers to guide transitions, and integration with carbon stock and flow modeling. It includes quantitative evaluation such as model verification against area targets and sensitivity analyses using Monte Carlo simulations, demonstrating spatially-explicit projections and uncertainty assessment over a 100-year simulation. The focus is clearly on LULC prediction as a central research question with multiple scenarios, national-scale spatial modeling, and mapped future projections, meeting all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
